vignette: A patient returns for a scheduled follow-up after a luxation injury to a permanent maxillary incisor. The patient reports no pain or other complaints.
stem: Which content is appropriate for this follow-up visit?

options.text: A clinical examination alone, since the patient has no complaints
Questioning about symptoms, clinical and radiographic examination, and pulp sensibility testing
Radiographs only if the patient reports symptoms
Pulp sensibility testing only at the first visit and not at later follow-ups
